author: aidan_mclau
text:
fun idea for measuring OOD benchmark perf:
>take an llm training corpus (pre + mid + post)
>chunk and embed it
>benchmark the model normally
>for each benchmark q, retrieve the k most similar chunks
>divide total benchmark perf by summed similarity
